title: A deps verb: devbin fetches a project's dependencies, so a driver need not call the language's own tool
objective: devbin fetches each declared language's dependencies, eg `mix deps.get`, so a driver that must fetch them runs `bin/devbin` and not the language's own tool.
body:
## The gap

Another workstream's close-out found it on 2026-11-27, and devbin-vc passed it on: devbin has no verb that fetches dependencies, so that workstream's driver called `mix deps.get` directly. A project builds and tests through `bin/devbin` alone, so that call steps outside it.

## What devbin has today

- `check deps` (catalogue row `check.deps`, elixir) runs `mix deps.unlock --check-unused`. It checks, and fetches nothing.
- `clean elixir` leaves the sources under `deps/`.
- No catalogue row and no handler fetches dependencies.

## Open

- Its shape, a command or an option of an existing one, is devbin-ic's word, and a new public verb is hv's call.
- Which languages it covers, eg elixir (`mix deps.get`) and rust (`cargo fetch`), and whether it seals a verdict.
- Size S, as a first estimate.
